name: refuse-tangent-blend-in-bounds
why: The tangent blend at the size it was found on, where the broken geometry stays inside the part's own bounding box. Containment passes; only BRepCheck_Analyzer catches it. This is the case that fails if the validity gate is removed, and the shape it would then accept has 22 open edges.

message_contains: node 4 (stock) unions node 3 blends by 2 mm
